text:
sara-cs: FYI customer C-9842 reporting sustained 429s and large tail latency on Dedicated in eu-south-1. Started ~08:05 UTC, affecting a handful of tenants. They see failures on both generation and embeddings.

oncall-eng: looking now, can you drop logs/error codes?

sara-cs: copy from customer: `error: http 429 from inference-service node=gpu-d-12 elapsed=00:00:00.120 tenant=acme-corp route=dedi-eu-south request_id=tx-9f2a` they also sent a stacktrace showing retries and then 503. p95 token latency spiking to 2.4s.

infra-bot: [alert] region eu-south-1: dedicated_pool_utilization=98% gpu_free=0 autoscaler_blocked=true (reason: quota_limit_reached)

ben-infra: confirmed the alert. Autoscaler tried to request more capacity but cloud returned quota_exceeded for GPUs in eu-south-1. Quota remaining=0.

oncall-eng: that explains throttling. Do we have spare capacity in nearby regions?

megan-ops: eu-west-1 has ~12 spare GPUs but network egress and auth routing need to be checked for these tenants. We can failover routing for affected customers if approved.

-tier2-support: repro steps from our side: 1) hit dedicated endpoint `POST /v1/dedicated/generate` with batch_size=48 2) observe 429s after ~150 req/min 3) logs show backend queue timeout `queue_timeout_ms=1200`. Repro verified on a repro tenant.

ben-infra: quick mitigation options: (A) request emergency quota bump with cloud provider (can take 20-45m) (B) spin up in eu-west-1 and failover routing (manual steps below) (C) reduce per-tenant concurrency to alleviate queueing. I'll start (C) and open the emergency quota ticket.

ben-infra: manual routing command (will run if we get 👍): `rproxy update-route --tenant acme-corp --from-region eu-south-1 --to-region eu-west-1 --weight 1.0 --force`

megan-ops: I'll coordinate the routing and update the firewall/NAT as needed. Note: customers using VPC peering may need IP allowlist changes.

-dave-ml: for medium-term, suggest switching to a smaller quantized model variant for these tenants to reduce GPU memory and allow packing more replicas. I can prepare model variant v2-q4 for canary.

sre-pager: paging infra-lead @ben-infra on-call. Also linking incident runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-capacity.

ben-infra: started reducing max_concurrency for affected tenant to 4 -> reduced error rate by ~70% in the repro test. Still seeing elevated latencies for queued requests.

megan-ops: initiated cross-region failover for acme-corp and two other tenants. Failover started at 08:22 UTC. Notifying customers with ETA 45m.

infra-bot: [action] emergency quota ticket opened with provider: TICKET-8345 status=pending.

-tier2-support: Customer updated: "Thanks, we see improved success rate after you routed to eu-west-1. Some requests still slow, but workable."

ben-infra: follow-ups: 1) confirm quota bump or capacity in eu-south-1 2) run postmortem on autoscaler rejection path and add metric for quota_rejections 3) add automatic cross-region spillover policy for Dedicated when regional available_gpus < 5.

sara-cs: noted. I'll keep C-9842 updated and schedule a customer debrief when stable.

megan-ops: retro task created: INFRA-2126 (autoscaler hard-fail on quota -> fall back to region spillover).

sre-pager: closing alert when all tenants show healthy and error_rate < 1% for 30m. Current status: in mitigation, monitoring. :thumbsup:

sara-cs: thanks all — marking thread as active until we have postmortem.
